description: Result of a GitHub Actions run-trigger operation. Every method returns a JSON object whose shape depends on the method.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation of the operation that was performed.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status line returned by the GitHub API, e.g. "204 No Content" or "202 Accepted".

httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the GitHub API, e.g. 204 or 202.

anyOf.title: run_workflow
anyOf.description: Returned by method=run_workflow: a workflow_dispatch event was created.

workflow_type.description: How the workflow was addressed: "workflow_id" when the workflow_id argument parsed as a numeric ID, "workflow_file" when it was treated as a workflow file name.

workflow_id.description: The workflow ID or workflow file name exactly as supplied by the caller.

ref.description: The git reference (branch or tag) the workflow was dispatched against.

inputs.description: The workflow inputs supplied by the caller, echoed back verbatim. Null when no inputs were provided.

anyOf.title: rerun_workflow_run, rerun_failed_jobs, cancel_workflow_run, delete_workflow_run_logs
anyOf.description: Returned by method=rerun_workflow_run, rerun_failed_jobs, cancel_workflow_run and delete_workflow_run_logs. All four return the same acknowledgement shape; only the message text differs.

run_id.description: The workflow run ID the operation was applied to.
